messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- Boreal handed billing-api to Team Dune on 2026-03-25. [decision; valid 2026-03-25 to now; recorded by handover/2026-03-25-billing-api]
- Billing-api depends on Ledger to work. [constraint; valid 2026-03-05 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-05]
- Billing-api depends on the flags service as of 2025-10-21. [valid 2025-10-21 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-10-21]
- Team Atlas pinged the owners of billing-api on 2025-12-31. [valid 2025-12-31 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-31]
- Changes to billing-api need a rollback plan attached to the pull request. [constraint; valid 2025-07-03 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-03]
- Billing-api is owned by Team Dune as of 2026-03-25, after Boreal handed it over. [decision; valid 2026-03-25 to now; recorded by handover/2026-03-25-billing-api]
    earlier: Billing-api is owned by Boreal as of 2025-12-24, after Team Atlas handed it over. [decision; valid 2025-12-24 to 2026-03-25; recorded by handover/2025-12-24-billing-api]
    earlier: Team Atlas owns billing-api as of 2025-01-08. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-12-24; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2]
- Billing-api has a deploy freeze from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02 during the peak season. [constraint; valid 2025-11-11 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-11-11]
- Priya walked Lena through the billing-api runbook on 2025-12-24. [valid 2025-12-24 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-24-billing-api]
- Team Atlas saw on 2026-04-16 that billing-api's error rate crept up to 2 percent following the dependency bump. [valid 2026-04-16 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-16]
- Cinder owns the notifier as of 2025-11-19; Boreal owned it until that date. [decision; valid 2025-11-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-19-notifier]
    earlier: Boreal owns notifier. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-11-19; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09]
- Farah and Tomasz are the members of Team Dune as of 2025-07-21. [valid 2025-07-21 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-21]
    earlier: Farah is the sole member of Team Dune as of 2025-01-09. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-07-21; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-09]
- After the marketing send, billing-api's queue depth hit 50,000. [valid 2025-08-08 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-08-08]
- Priya wrote up the handover doc for Lena for the Ledger handover on 2025-12-10. [valid 2025-12-10 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-10-ledger]
- Oskar wrote up the handover doc for Farah for the job scheduler handover on 2025-04-04. [valid 2025-04-04 to now; recorded by handover/2025-04-04-scheduler]
- Oskar wrote up the handover doc for Priya for the webhooks service handover on 2025-09-09. [valid 2025-09-09 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-09-webhooks]
- As of 2026-05-01, Ledger deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC instead of on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC. [decision; valid 2026-05-01 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-05-01]
- Marcus Oyelaran wrote up the handover doc for Tomasz for the event bus handover on 2025-09-09. [valid 2025-09-09 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-09-event-bus]
- The reports pipeline went to Boreal as of 2025-06-25, not Ember; Team Ember never owned it, and Team Dune no longer owns it. [decision; valid 2025-07-03 to now; recorded by handover/2025-07-03-reporting-correction]
    earlier: Team Ember owns the reports pipeline as of 2025-06-25, and Team Dune no longer owns it. [decision; valid 2025-06-25 to 2025-07-03; recorded by handover/2025-06-25-reporting]
    earlier: Team Dune owns the reporting service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-06-25; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20-2]
- Team Atlas noticed on 2025-12-31 that billing-api's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade. [valid 2025-12-31 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-31]
- Priya walked Diego through the flags service runbook on 2025-02-13 as part of the handover. [valid 2025-02-13 to now; recorded by handover/2025-02-13-feature-flags]
